decisions.evidence: Rule already pairs catalytic and small/regulatory subunits of two AHAS isozymes (Shew_0289+Shew_0290 'acetolactate synthase 2 catalytic/regulatory subunit'; Shew_1776+Shew_1775 'acetolactate synthase 3 catalytic/regulatory subunit'); both complexes are genuine, no change needed.

Outer-membrane diffusion step; alternatives are two 'porin' genes (Shew_2283, Shew_2481) and two OmpA/MotB-domain lipoproteins (Shew_0908 YiaD-family, Shew_1792 PdsO). Removing the lipoproteins would leave only generic 'porin' annotations, which the procedure forbids, so the rule is left unchanged.

Shew_1425 'adenylyl-sulfate kinase' (CysC) sits in the sulfate-activation operon with Shew_1422/Shew_1423 'sulfate adenylyltransferase' subunits (PAPS reductase Shew_0667 present); Shew_1574 'ATP-binding Mrp/Nbp35 family protein' / 'iron-sulfur cluster carrier protein ApbC' is an Fe-S carrier NTPase with a different activity, so it is removed.
Shew_1117 is NagA ('N-acetylglucosamine-6-phosphate deacetylase'); Shew_0013 carries a family-level 'amidohydrolase' annotation (NagA's superfamily), which may not be removed.

Shew_0205 'argininosuccinate synthase' (ArgG, EC 6.3.4.5) in the arg cluster; Shew_0206 'argininosuccinate lyase' (ArgH, EC 4.3.2.1) catalyses the next step, a different reaction and EC number, so it is removed.

Shew_1509 'asparagine synthetase B'; Shew_3038 is annotated 'asparagine synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing)' in the Fitness Browser (same name) although RefSeq calls it N-acetylglutaminylglutamine amidotransferase; same-name/conflicting annotation, so not removed.
All three are genuine aspartokinases: Shew_0521 AK II/HSD II (MetL), Shew_0779 'aspartate kinase III' (LysC), Shew_1079 AK I/HSD I (ThrA); the isozyme OR rule is correct.
Shew_0130 and Shew_1427 are both '3'(2'),5'-bisphosphate nucleotidase CysQ' (same-name paralogs); never removed.
Shew_1072 'chorismate mutase' and Shew_1068 'bifunctional chorismate mutase/prephenate dehydrogenase' (TyrA) both carry chorismate mutase activity; correct isozyme rule.

removed by the noIonR6 filter (R6 on an inorganic-ion transport reaction); original: Shew_1015 'Cl- channel, voltage-gated family protein' is the genome's only ClC-family chloride transporter; bacterial ClC proteins are 2Cl-/1H+ exchangers, matching this reaction's substrate and stoichiometry.

Removing the lipoproteins would leave only generic 'porin' annotations, which the procedure forbids, so the rule is left unchanged.

No copper uptake permease is annotated: copper-named transport genes are efflux systems (Shew_3818 'copper-translocating P-type ATPase', CzcA family) or a NosL/NosD-associated ABC permease subunit (Shew_0357 'copper ABC transporter, permease protein'), an ATP-driven multicomponent system tied to multicopper-enzyme maturation, not this H+-independent uptake permease.
Shew_2382 'cysteine synthase A' plus Shew_2060 'PLP-dependent cysteine synthase family protein', a family-level annotation compatible with the reaction; not removed.
Shew_0851, Shew_1067 and Shew_1547 are all 'phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxyheptonate aldolase' / 3-deoxy-7-phosphoheptulonate synthase paralogs (DAHP synthase isozymes).

Shew_0292 'dihydroxy-acid dehydratase' (IlvD) lies in the ilv cluster (AHAS, IlvE, threonine dehydratase); Shew_1436 'pterin-4-alpha-carbinolamine dehydratase' (PhhB, EC 4.2.1.96, 113 aa, phhA-phhB operon) acts on a pterin, a different substrate class and EC number, so it is removed.
Shew_1848 and Shew_2362 are both annotated 'dihydrodipicolinate synthase' (same-name paralogs) and are kept, although Shew_2362 sits in a proline-racemase/D-amino-acid dehydrogenase cluster.

Shew_0874 'dihydrofolate reductase' (FolA) plus Shew_0048 'dihydromonapterin reductase' (FolM-type, known DHFR activity) and Shew_0776 'dihydrofolate reductase family protein'; compatible/family-level annotations, not removed.

Shew_1013 'aspartate carbamoyltransferase' (PyrB, EC 2.1.3.2) catalyses the preceding step, not dihydroorotate hydrolysis, so it is removed; Shew_0728 'dihydroorotase' (PyrC) and family-level Shew_2586 'amidohydrolase' are kept.

Shew_1102 'hydroxymethylbutenyl pyrophosphate reductase' (IspH, 4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate reductase) is the specific enzyme; Shew_1954 '30S ribosomal protein S1' is a ribosomal protein and is removed.
Shew_2895 '2-dehydropantoate 2-reductase' (PanE) plus Shew_0288 'ketol-acid reductoisomerase' (IlvC), which has known ketopantoate reductase side activity; compatible alternative, not removed.
Shew_0068 'class II fumarate hydratase' (FumC) and Shew_1904 'fumarate hydratase' (single-chain 508 aa class I Fe-S hydro-lyase); both genuine fumarases.

Shew_3554 'glutamine synthetase' plus Shew_0972 'glutamate--ammonia ligase' (same-name GS-family annotation; neighbourhood suggests a gamma-glutamylpolyamine synthetase, but same-name paralogs are never removed).
Diffusion step whose only alternatives are two 'porin' genes (Shew_2283, Shew_2481); no change.
Shew_1859 'carbonate dehydratase' or spontaneous CO2 hydration; the rule is appropriate.
Shew_0521 (AK II/HSD II) and Shew_1079 (AK I/HSD I) both carry homoserine dehydrogenase domains; correct isozyme rule.

Shew_1102 'hydroxymethylbutenyl pyrophosphate reductase' (IspH, 4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate reductase) is the specific enzyme; Shew_1954 '30S ribosomal protein S1' is a ribosomal protein and is removed.

No NAD-dependent L-lactate dehydrogenase (EC 1.1.1.27) is annotated in the genome; the only nearby candidate, Shew_3136 'FAD linked oxidase domain-containing protein', is a generic FAD-dependent oxidase, not this NAD-linked reaction.
Shew_3135 'L-lactate permease' (LctP family L-lactate:H+ symporter) is the specific transporter for this substrate and mechanism.

removed by the noIonR6 filter (R6 on an inorganic-ion transport reaction); original: Shew_2965 'putative manganese transporter' (423 aa, size of an NRAMP-type uptake carrier) is the only transporter annotated for Mn2+; assigned as the specific manganese transporter.

Shew_2310 'nucleoside-diphosphate kinase' (Ndk) plus Shew_2230 'adenylate kinase', an NMP kinase with documented NDP-kinase side activity; not clearly a non-catalyst, so not removed.
Shew_2310 'nucleoside-diphosphate kinase' (Ndk) plus Shew_2230 'adenylate kinase', an NMP kinase with documented NDP-kinase side activity; not clearly a non-catalyst, so not removed.

Shew_3814 'naphthoate synthase' (MenB, 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA synthase) is the specific enzyme; Shew_1960 is a 'hypothetical protein' (DUF2058) with no enzymatic annotation or menaquinone-gene context, so it is removed.
Shew_3471 '3-isopropylmalate dehydrogenase' (LeuB) or spontaneous beta-keto acid decarboxylation; the rule is appropriate.

Shew_2832 'phosphoglucosamine mutase' (GlmM) plus Shew_1922 'phosphoglucomutase', a member of the same phosphohexomutase superfamily acting on a closely related hexose phosphate; cross-specificity cannot be excluded, so not removed.
Generic aminotransferases (Shew_0291 'branched-chain amino acid aminotransferase', Shew_1999 'aromatic amino acid aminotransferase'); redundancy plausible.
Shew_2095 'phosphomethylpyrimidine kinase' (ThiD-type, EC 2.7.4.7) lies in the thiamine biosynthesis cluster with ThiC (Shew_2096), ThiS (Shew_2093) and ThiH (Shew_2091).
Shew_1975 'manganese-dependent inorganic pyrophosphatase' plus SurE nucleotidase (Shew_1210) and Ppx/GppA phosphatase (Shew_3078); phosphatase annotations may not be removed.

Shew_1862 'succinyl-diaminopimelate desuccinylase' (DapE) plus Shew_2160, 'hypothetical protein' in the Fitness Browser but 'dipeptidase' in RefSeq (broad-specificity peptidase annotation); not clearly a non-catalyst.

Shew_1041 'thymidylate synthase' (ThyA) is the genome's only thymidylate synthase; Shew_1942 'NADH:flavin oxidoreductase' / 'NADPH-dependent 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase' (FadH-type, EC 1.3.1.34) has a different activity and substrate class, so it is removed.
Shew_1192 'thiamine-monophosphate kinase' (ThiL) is the specific enzyme; Shew_2766 'tRNA uracil 4-sulfurtransferase ThiI' is a sulfurtransferase (EC 2.8.1.4), not a kinase, so it is removed.
Shew_1004 'undecaprenyl pyrophosphate phosphatase' (UppP) plus two PAP2-family phosphatases (Shew_0302, Shew_0036), a family with known undecaprenyl-diphosphate phosphatase members; not removed.
Shew_2633 'uridylate kinase' (PyrH) plus Shew_1953 'cytidylate kinase' (Cmk), an NMP kinase acting on the same substrate class (pyrimidine NMPs); not clearly a non-catalyst, left unchanged.
